sources.title: 2025 federal election — House of Representatives candidates (declared nominations, with ballot order)
sources.note: Canonical AEC House candidate download (columns: state, division, ballotPosition, surname, ballotGivenName, partyBallotName) — the primary aec.gov.au source of record, which carries both the candidate SET and the ballot ORDER. Catalogue: https://www.aec.gov.au/election/fe25/downloads-statistics.htm. Licence: CC BY 4.0 per the AEC website-wide copyright notice (https://www.aec.gov.au/footer/copyright.htm); redistribution permitted, so the raw CSV is retained in-repo and pinned by SHA-256. Verified 2026-07-17: the committed ballots.json reproduces this file EXACTLY — 1126/1126 House candidates across 150/150 divisions, matching on (state, division, ballot position, candidate, party).

sources.title: 2025 federal election — Senate candidates (declared nominations, with group + ballot order)
sources.note: Canonical AEC Senate candidate download (columns: state, column, ballotPosition, surname, ballotGivenName, groupName, partyBallotName) — the primary aec.gov.au source of record, carrying the Senate candidate SET, group columns and within-group ballot ORDER. Licence: CC BY 4.0 per the AEC website-wide copyright notice; raw retained + SHA-256 pinned. Verified 2026-07-17: ballots.json reproduces this file EXACTLY — 330/330 Senate candidates across 8 jurisdictions, matching on (state, group, ballot position, candidate, party).

sources.title: 2025 federal election — electoral divisions
sources.note: The set of 150 contesting electoral divisions is the distinct (state, division) values in the canonical House candidate download (same retained file as house-nominations). Verified 2026-07-17: 150/150 division names match ballots.json.
